Blocks.Text: The Employer Brand APIs enable organizations to manage and retrieve content for their LinkedIn Company Pages, including the Life tab, career page settings, analytics, and more. These APIs provide programmatic access to the data and settings that help companies showcase their culture, values, and workplace to potential candidates and visitors.
The Life tab on a LinkedIn Company Page is based on two key backend concepts:

Targeted Content
Content Revisions

Targeted content is the Life page variant for an organization, including modules (such as photos, articles, testimonials, and featured members or leaders) and the audience targeting rules that determine visibility. This is available through the OrganizationTargetedContent resource.

Each time an admin creates a new company page version, a new targeted content ID is generated. When targeted content is created, a new content revision is also automatically generated to capture the page's state.

Targeting Attributes: Typical targeting attributes include language, location, job function, industry, company size, and seniority. These attributes determine which Life page variant is displayed to a member.

Key Fields: Targeted content entries include identifiers such as a per-version ID and a shared reportingId that links all versions of the same page over time. An originType field may also indicate whether the page was manually authored or AI-assisted.

Content revision is the version-history record of a company's Life page. Each time a Life page is saved or published, a new version with a unique ID is created, and the system writes a ContentRevision that references the targeted contents in that version. Previously, versions accumulated indefinitely.

Admins author targeted content (the page variant plus targeting rules). Creating or editing that content generates a new content revision representing the current state. On the member-facing Company Page, the Life tab uses targeting logic to determine which page variant is presented, and ordering can differ based on how a member’s profile matches the company’s targeting settings.

Rows.Text: Admin Content
Retrieve media gallery assets (images, videos) for your organization.
r_dma_admin_pages_content with ADMINISTRATOR or CONTENT_ADMINISTRATOR role.
Organization Targeted Contents
Retrieve Life page variants with audience targeting rules and content modules.
r_dma_admin_pages_content with ADMINISTRATOR or CONTENT_ADMINISTRATOR role.
Organization Content Revisions
Retrieve version history of Life page changes, including published and draft states.
r_dma_admin_pages_content with ADMINISTRATOR or CONTENT_ADMINISTRATOR role.
Organization Photos
Retrieve photos uploaded for display on the organization page.
r_dma_admin_pages_content with ADMINISTRATOR or CONTENT_ADMINISTRATOR role.
Organization Commitment
Retrieve organization commitments data (e.g., Diversity, Equity & Inclusion).
r_dma_admin_pages_content with ADMINISTRATOR or CONTENT_ADMINISTRATOR role.
Organization Workplace Policies
Retrieve workplace policy data (hybrid, remote, onsite) for the organization.
r_dma_admin_pages_content with ADMINISTRATOR or CONTENT_ADMINISTRATOR role.
Career Page Settings
Retrieve career page configuration including module visibility and automatic job posting settings.
r_dma_admin_pages_content with ADMINISTRATOR or CONTENT_ADMINISTRATOR role.
Organization Life Page Traffic Statistics
Retrieve page view and unique visitor counts for Life page variants.
r_dma_admin_pages_content with ADMINISTRATOR, CONTENT_ADMINISTRATOR, or ANALYST role.
Organization Relationship Statistics
Retrieve relationship statistics between your organization and related organizations.
r_dma_admin_pages_content with ADMINISTRATOR, CONTENT_ADMINISTRATOR, ANALYST, or LEAD_GEN_FORMS_MANAGER role.
Talent Brand Analytic Summaries
Retrieve talent brand analytics including career page visitor data by time range.
r_dma_admin_pages_content with ADMINISTRATOR, CONTENT_ADMINISTRATOR, ANALYST, or LEAD_GEN_FORMS_MANAGER role.

Blocks.Text: Most Employer Brand APIs require the r_dma_admin_pages_content permission, which allows you to:

Retrieve your organization's posts, comments, reactions, and other engagement data.
Retrieve your organization's pages and their reporting data (including follower, visitor, and content analytics).
This permission is restricted to organizations in which the authenticated member has one of the following company page roles:

ADMINISTRATOR - Full access to all content and settings.
CONTENT_ADMINISTRATOR - Access to content management features.
ANALYST - Access to analytics and reporting features (for analytics APIs only).
LEAD_GEN_FORMS_MANAGER - Access to lead generation and analytics features (for some analytics APIs).
For more information on company page roles, refer to Organization Access Control.
All Employer Brand APIs do not obfuscate member personal data. These APIs focus on organization-level content and aggregate analytics, not individual member data.
To use these APIs:

Determine which organizations you can query: Use OrganizationAuthorization's BATCH_FIND method with the appropriate authorization action for your use case.

Understand URN encoding: Most APIs require URL-encoded URNs. Example: urn:li:organization:1234 becomes urn%3Ali%3Aorganization%3A1234.

Review API-specific requirements: Each API has specific query parameters and response formats detailed in their respective documentation pages.
Combine Organization Targeted Contents and Organization Life Page Traffic Statistics to create a dashboard showing which page variants are performing best with different audiences.
Use Organization Content Revisions to track the complete history of Life page modifications, including who made changes and when content was published.
Leverage Talent Brand Analytic Summaries and Organization Relationship Statistics to understand how your employer brand resonates with different audiences and organizations.
Use Admin Content and Organization Photos to retrieve and manage the visual assets displayed on your organization page.
